verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits right on the olive circle and wraps to leave 'fizz' orphaned on its own line. The 'Find a Store' CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill crammed against the bottom edge, which buries the action, and the bottom is jammed while the pack takes up most of the height. B: the CITRINE wordmark has moved below the headline, which breaks the brand-first reading order. The CTA is oversized and sits after a large dead gap. Even so, the headline is on one line, the text is clear of the circles, and the hierarchy is legible, so B is the less broken of the two.
